definitions.generation: Hypothesis st.randoms(use_true_random=False) with fixed seeds; uniqueness by canonical scenario hash
definitions.lost_update: an accepted write whose CHANGE vs its own base is missing from the new head, or a value it did not change that the previous head had (raw Git)

oracle.input: logical state read from raw Git with the git CLI (eoo_h19/rawgit.py), never from the Engine or the GitStore
oracle.model: oracles/h19/model.py: immutable commit DAG + deterministic projection hash + three-way merge
